baselineDisplay.title: 一次成功的手术
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】一次成功的手术
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Did the doctors find out how the woman died?
问题：医生们找到这位女士的死因了吗？
• 词汇准备
• mummy 木乃伊
• Egyptian 埃及的
• mark 斑点
• plate （照相）底片
• disease 疾病
• last 持续
• prove 显示出
• resin 树脂
• skin 皮肤
• section 切片
• figure (人的)体形;人像
• normally 通常地
• survive 幸免于
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.
死于公元前 800 年的一位埃及妇女的木乃伊刚刚接受了一次手术。
As there were strange marks on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy, doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease.
由于在给这个木乃伊拍摄的 X 光片子上有点奇怪的斑点，所以，医生们一直试图搞清这位妇女是否死于一种罕见的疾病。
The only way to do this was to operate. The operation, which lasted for over four hours, proved to be very difficult because of the hard resin which covered the skin.
搞清的唯一办法就是手术。手术持续了 4 个多小时，非常难做，因为皮肤上覆盖着一层硬硬的树脂。
The doctors removed a section of the mummy and sent it to a laboratory.
医生们从木乃伊身上取下一个切片，送去化验。
They also found something which the X-ray plates did not show: a small wax figure of a god.
他们还发现了 X 光片所没有显示的东西: 一个蜡制的神之塑像。
This god which has the head of a cow was normally placed inside a mummy.
这种牛头人身的神像通常被放在木乃伊体内。
The doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
医生们至今还未确定这位妇女的死因。
They feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open, but fortunately this has not happened.
他们曾担心在把木乃伊切开后，它会散成碎片，但幸运得很，这种情况并未发生。
The mummy successfully survived the operation.
这具木乃伊成功地经受了这次手术。
• Step 3: Summary writing.
第三步：摘要写作。
CONNECTIONS POINTS
who 1 Doctors operated--mummy: Egyptian woman.
2 Died 800 B.C.
whether 3 Wanted to find out—died rare disease.
After removing 4 Removed section.
5 Sent it to laboratory.
During the operation 6 Unexpectedly found a figure-god.
Though 7 Afraid mummy fall to pieces.
8 Survived operation.
Answer: Doctors have just operated on the mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. They wanted to find out whether she died of a rare disease. After removing a section of the mummy, they sent it to a laboratory. During the operation, they unexpectedly found a small wax figure of a god. Though they were afraid the mummy would fall to pieces, it successfully survived the operation.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1. Doctors operated on the mummy _________.
(a) to find out what he woman had died of
(b) to find out what was inside it
(c) to remove a small wax figure of the god, Duamutef
(d) because the woman died of rare disease
2. The doctors __________.
(a) found out what they were looking for
(b) couldn't prevent the mummy from falling to pieces
(c) haven't yet found out what they were looking for
(d) expected to find the small wax figure inside the mummy
3. What did the woman die of? _________ did the woman die?
(a) How
(b) Where
(c) What
(d) When
4. The only way to do this. There was only one way _________ doing this.
(a) in
(b) of
(c) by
(d) to
5. The operation proved to be very difficult. It proved to be _______ operation.
(a) difficult
(b) the difficult
(c) a difficult
(d) difficult the
6. It was difficult because of the hard resin ________ the skin.
(a) covered
(b) which covering
(c) in covering
(d) covering
7. They haven't decided yet. They are _________ undecided.
(a) even
(b) yet
(c) more
(d) still
8. An operation is usually performed by a _________.
(a) doctor
(b) dentist
(c) scientist
(d) surgeon
9. There were strange ________ on the X-ray plates.
(a) markings
(b) notes
(c) signs
(d) messages
10. They wanted to know if the woman had died of a rare _______.
(a) illness
(b) pain
(c) ache
(d) hurt
11. The operation lasted for over four hours That's how long it ________.
(a) went
(b) went on
(c) went over
(d) went off
12. There was a small wax figure in it. It was _________.
(a) a carving
(b) a shape
(c) a number
(d) a body
Key: 1 a 2 c 3 a 4 b 5 c 6 d 7 d 8 d 9 a 10 a 11 b 12 a
第六十单元【语法点拨】 语法综合测试一
1. It is essential that these application forms _________ back as early as possible.
A. must be sent
B. are sent
C. will be sent
D. be sent
1. D.
2. He thought that _________.
A. the effort doing the job was not worth
B. the effort was not worth in doing the job
C. it was not worth the effort doing the job
D. it was not worth the effort by doing the job
2. C
3. If I hadn't stood under the ladder to catch you when you fell, you _________ now.
A. wouldn't be smiling
B. won't smile
C. couldn't have smiled
D. didn't smile
3. A
4. It's no use _________ me not to worry.
A. you tell
B. your telling
C. for you to have told
D. having told
4. B
5. You ________ him so closely; you should have kept your distance.
A. shouldn't have been following
B. mustn't follow
C. couldn't have been following
D. shouldn't follow
5. A
6. As Commander-in-Chief of the armed forces, I have directed that all measures _____ for our defense.
A. had been taken
B. be taken
C. would be taken
D. to be taken
6. B
7. __________ an important decision more on emotion than on reason, you will regret it sooner or later.
A. Based
B. Basing
C. Base
D. To Base
7. B
8. The new law states that people ________ drive after drinking alcohol.
A. wouldn't
B. needn't
C. won't
D. mustn't
8. D
9. We didn't know his telephone number; otherwise we _________ him.
A. would have telephoned
B. would telephone
C. must have telephoned
D. had telephoned
9. A
10. I'd rather have a room of my own, however small it is, than ________ a room with someone else.
A. share
B. to share
C. sharing
D. to have shared
10. A
【课后练习】这部分不做进课件而是放进讲义里
11. You may depend on it _______ they will support you.
A. what
B. which
C. that
D. how
11. C。that 从句一般不可以直接用作介词的宾语,但可跟在形式宾语 it 之后,作介词的实际宾语。
12. The sale usually takes place outside the house, with the audience _______ on benches, chairs or boxes.
A. having seated
B. seating
C. seated
D. having been seated
12. C。分词的独立主格结构。分词作状语时,其逻辑主语必须和主句的主语一致,否则,分词必须有自己的主语,这种带主语的分词被称为分词的独立结构。有时可用 with 或 without 来引导独立结构,其形式为 with/without 名词/代词宾格分词。
13. She ought to stop working; she has a headache because she _________ too long.
A. has been reading
C. is reading
B. had read
D. read
13. A。时态的用法。现在完成进行时表示谓语动作从过去某时开始延续到现在,很可能还要延续下去。
14. It seems oil __________ from this pipe for some time. We'll have to take the machine apart to put it right.
A. had leaked
B. is leaking
C. leaked
D. has been leaking
14. D。时态的用法。参看第 13 题的解释。
15. ________ the temperature falling so rapidly we couldn't go on with the experiment.
A. Since
B. For
C. As
D. With
15. D。参看第 12 题的解释。
16. After the Arab states won independence, great emphasis was laid on expanding education, with girls as well as boys _________ to go to school.
A. to be encouraged
B. been encouraged
C. being encouraged
D. be encouraged
16. C。参看第 12 题的解释。
17. So many directors ________, the board meeting had to be put off.
A. were absent
B. been absent
C. had been absent
D. being absent
17. D。分词的独立主格结构。分词作状语时,其逻辑主语必须和主句的主语一致,否则,分词必须有自己的主语,这种带主语的分词被称为分词的独立结构。现在分词表示主动,即逻辑主语发出、做出某个动作。该句中 absent 缺席)是董事们主动做出的行为,因此用现在分词。
18. I was halfway back to the cottage where my mother lived ______ Susan caught up with me.
A. when
B. while
C. until
D. though
18. A。when 引导时间状语从句。When 在此意为“在那个时候”。
19. had just started back for the house to change my clothes ________ heard voices.
A. as
B. when
C. after
D. while
19. B。when 引导的并列结构,意为“正在这个时候”。
20. I felt somewhat disappointed and was about to leave, ________ something occurred which attracted my attention.
A. unless
B. until
C. when
D. while
20. C。参看第 19 题的解释。

blocks.text: 【故事复现】一次成功的手术
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Did the doctors find out how the woman died?
问题：医生们找到这位女士的死因了吗？
• 词汇准备
• mummy 木乃伊
• Egyptian 埃及的
• mark 斑点
• plate （照相）底片
• disease 疾病
• last 持续
• prove 显示出
• resin 树脂
• skin 皮肤
• section 切片
• figure (人的)体形;人像
• normally 通常地
• survive 幸免于
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。

The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.
死于公元前 800 年的一位埃及妇女的木乃伊刚刚接受了一次手术。
As there were strange marks on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy, doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease.
由于在给这个木乃伊拍摄的 X 光片子上有点奇怪的斑点，所以，医生们一直试图搞清这位妇女是否死于一种罕见的疾病。
The only way to do this was to operate. The operation, which lasted for over four hours, proved to be very difficult because of the hard resin which covered the skin.
搞清的唯一办法就是手术。手术持续了 4 个多小时，非常难做，因为皮肤上覆盖着一层硬硬的树脂。

The doctors removed a section of the mummy and sent it to a laboratory.
医生们从木乃伊身上取下一个切片，送去化验。
They also found something which the X-ray plates did not show: a small wax figure of the god Duamutef.
他们还发现了X光片所没有显示的东西：一个蜡制的杜阿穆特夫神像。

This figure of the jackal-headed god Duamutef had been placed inside the mummy.
这尊豺首神杜阿穆特夫的塑像被放在木乃伊体内。

The doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
医生们至今还未确定这位妇女的死因。
They feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open, but fortunately this has not happened.
他们曾担心在把木乃伊切开后，它会散成碎片，但幸运得很，这种情况并未发生。

The mummy successfully survived the operation.
这具木乃伊成功地经受了这次手术。
• Step 3: Summary writing.
第三步：摘要写作。
CONNECTIONS POINTS

who 1 Doctors operated--mummy: Egyptian woman.
2 Died 800 B.C.
whether 3 Wanted to find out—died rare disease.

After removing 4 Removed section.
5 Sent it to laboratory.
During the operation 6 Unexpectedly found a figure-god.

Though 7 Afraid mummy fall to pieces.
8 Survived operation.

Answer: Doctors have just operated on the mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. They wanted to find out whether she died of a rare disease. After removing a section of the mummy, they sent it to a laboratory. During the operation, they unexpectedly found a small wax figure of a god. Though they were afraid the mummy would fall to pieces, it successfully survived the operation.
